listing:description.back: QuickStudy turns the pages you already have into flashcards you really study with. Scan a worksheet, import a PDF or paste your notes: QuickStudy creates the cards, links each to its source and schedules them so you only review what is due. [Sections: turn any page into flashcards; study only what is due today, with "Today" showing one session with the due cards and your weakest card; quiz yourself in minutes; know why each answer is right; learn from every mistake; build a daily study routine, earning a streak protection for every full study week; track progress in every subject; private by default, where the server drafts with Claude by Anthropic and Claude deletes your text within 30 days; free and Pro with 10 free AI generations a month, 150 cloud generations a month for Pro, charged to the Apple Account, auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, manage or cancel in Apple Account settings.]

Also Serienpause -> Serienschutz (einen) and quotes around „Heute“ so it reads as the tab, not the adverb.

listing:release_notes.back: QuickStudy 2.0 was completely rebuilt around daily studying. ONE SESSION A DAY: Today shows only the due cards plus your weakest card; streaks count the days you study and each full study week earns a Streak Freeze. FROM PAGE TO CARDS, FASTER: scan with the camera, choose a photo, import a PDF or paste text; keep using the app while your cards are drafted; every draft is kept by default, tap to edit, swipe to remove. KNOW WHY: each card links back to the page and passage it came from; every answer explains why it is right, and missed cards come back tomorrow. NOW IN YOUR LANGUAGE: QuickStudy is available in Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean and Portuguese; cards are drafted in the language of your notes, whatever language your iPhone uses; scanning reads pages in those languages and spell-checking follows the language of each page. QUICKSTUDY PRO: an optional subscription with 150 cloud generations a month on any iPhone; typing your own cards and every study mode remain free and unlimited; if a draft would leave your iPhone, QuickStudy asks first.
listing:release_notes.note: Rewritten for 2.0 on 2026-11-12 to cover the whole update, reusing reviewed wording from the description and the in-app What's New. Reviewer found nothing to change. 'komplett neu' adds an intensifier but matches the in-app string; 'Eigene Karten einzugeben und alle Lernmodi bleiben' is clunky but matches description.txt; 'Das Scannen liest' is literal. Revise together with those sources if ever changed.
